Seal.title: Seal
Seal.description: A password-protected secret seal (Thiên Ấn) where the answer is hashed with Argon2id and the secret content is encrypted server-side in sealedEnvelope.

id.description: Cryptographically random unique identifier for the seal.

name.description: Public display name of the Thiên Ấn.

question.description: Public question that the solver must answer.

hint.description: Optional public hint for the solver.

instructions.description: Optional public instructions on how to format the answer.

sealedEnvelope.description: Server-side AES-256-GCM + Argon2id encrypted envelope containing the password hash and locked secret content.

createdAtIso.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp generated by the server.

/seals/{sealId}.description: Stores immutable Thiên Ấn records with server-encrypted envelopes.
